en.headline: Asset-inventory and skill releases dominate a busy 30-day window
en.teaser: sogeisetsu shipped 17 asset-inventory releases and a 368-commit automated profile update, while filing 59 issues across OpenChamber and OpenCode.
en.overview:
### Own projects

Most of the coding effort went into `sogeisetsu/asset-inventory`, which moved through a long chain of releases from v1.3.0 to v1.15.0. The work covered an English-first rewrite with paired Chinese docs, a seven-language documentation site, rendered bilingual sample pages, a new broken-state marker for registered but uninvokable assets, security guards for discovery, a release-prep script with a docs-parity gate, and a registry-first host-command scan. Documentation checks were automated through a PR-triggered workflow, and the SKILL.md text was trimmed repeatedly.

A second cluster of work went into `sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch`, which grew from v0.1.0 to v0.4.0. The releases added rule-based handling for unavailable sources, a validator that explains failures, a family of three cooperating skills, a thin `meld.py` CLI wrapping the gate scripts, a bilingual Pages landing page with light and dark themes, and validation scripts with CI.

The OpenCode skill tooling also moved forward. `opencode-go-model-picker` shipped v1.0.0 through v1.4.0 with plan-aware model allocation, a three-part output, agent discovery scripts and proxy-aware network helpers. `opencode-skill-management` reached v0.2.0 with a plugin that lists, inspects, disables and enables skills through a config permission rule, and `opencode-agent-sandbox` accumulated knowledge notes in the initial commit series.

### Profile and blog

`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` was reworked heavily: all copy switched to English, a 30-day activity card was added with a daily workflow that later moved to rolling two-hour updates, statistics were made consistent with their breakdowns, and CI actions were upgraded to drop the deprecated Node 20 runtime. The blog repository received three OpenChamber capture samples.

### Upstream reporting

Outside own repositories, most activity was issue reporting. 30 issues went to `openchamber/openchamber`, covering multi-run cleanup and orphaned MCP processes, stale-save overwrites of AGENTS.md, model switching losing thinking level, Context panel breakdown math, and missing auto-update manifests. 12 issues went to `anomalyco/opencode`, mainly MiMo model vision and subagent failures on the Go endpoint plus Windows CLI access. Smaller reports covered OpenCode V2 compatibility for skill plugins and skill install paths.

Backfill limits apply: the first days of the window were reconstructed through GitHub Search, so star counts are unavailable and releases cover only own repositories. No days are missing from the window.

highlights.text: v1.7.0 merged: seven languages, Material docs site, rendered examples.
Registry-first host-command scan so inventories stop losing registered commands.
Thin meld.py CLI wrapping six gate scripts, plus a lighter skill body.
skill_management plugin lists, inspects, disables and enables skills via a config rule.
Deleting a multi-run leaves orphaned MCP child processes and blocks git worktree remove.
MiMo V2.6/V2.5 advertise image input but the Go endpoint rejects every image with 400.
Eval robustness hardened in parsing, aggregation and install; closed on 2026-10-01.
Proposal to store relay identity keys encrypted at rest and out of settings.json backups.

byRepo.text: 139 own commits and no automated commits, 16 PRs, 17 releases. The release train ran from v1.3.0 to v1.15.0: English-first restructuring with a paired Chinese doc set, a seven-language docs site, rendered sample pages built by `build-sample-pages.mjs`, a 🛑broken state marker across seven locales, MCP probing and update.ps1 fixes, security guards for discovery, a release-prep script with a docs-parity gate, and a registry-first host-command scan.

103 own commits plus 363 automated commits, 5 issues. Copy was switched to English, a 30-day activity card was added with an automatic update workflow that later moved to two-hour rolling runs, daily-report commit accounting was corrected, checkout/setup-node were upgraded to v7 to drop Node 20, a .gitattributes LF rule was added, and a temporary smoke-test issue was opened and closed.

76 own commits and no automated commits, 4 releases. v0.1.0 through v0.4.0 added a SKILL.md with four reference documents, validation scripts with CI, a first-class observations evidence type, a bilingual Pages landing page, a Chinese README with local-only translations, three cooperating skills, and a thin `meld.py` CLI wrapping the six gate scripts.

No own commits, 30 issues and 9 ideas discussions started or joined. Reports covered orphaned MCP child processes after multi-run deletion, missing latest.yml auto-update manifests, stale-save overwrites of AGENTS.md, model switching keeping the wrong thinking level, Context panel breakdown percentages, 1x browser capture resolution, and unlinkable agent-linked issues.

24 own commits and no automated commits, 4 releases. v1.0.0 shipped plan-aware allocation with fallback chains and a two-question diagnostic; v1.1.0 reworked output into a three-part body plus appendix; v1.3.0 added discover-agents and snapshot-summary scripts; v1.4.0 added shared JSON and proxy helpers and richer agent metadata.

24 own commits and no automated commits, 1 release. The skill_management plugin was implemented and verified for list, inspect, disable and enable, the spec was revised after a feasibility review, plans moved into .openchamber/plans, line endings were unified to LF, and 0.1.0-rc.0 plus rc.1 validated trusted publishing over OIDC before v0.2.0.

18 own commits and no automated commits, no releases. The initial commit was followed by AGENTS.md and a knowledge base that was generalized beyond Git and GitHub, archiving findings on OpenCode V2 distribution, architecture, authentication, Windows path pitfalls, oh-my-opencode-slim and hosted OpenCode tests, plus corrections to stale subcommand and port notes.

No own commits, 12 issues filed. The main threads were MiMo V2.6 Flash vision reading stale images after five or more images, subagents failing with model_coming_soon, the Go endpoint rejecting advertised image input, a TinyFish websearch 400 over a missing Mcp-Session-Id, a removed auth.json not clearing models, and a request for a way to run the shipped CLI on Windows desktop.

No own commits, 8 PRs and 4 issues. Four fix PRs were opened and closed on the same day: disposing review servers on plugin unload, accepting CRLF frontmatter, opening review URLs with platform-specific browser commands, and hardening eval parsing, aggregation and install. Issues covered OpenCode V2 plugin load errors and dist rebuilds inlining dependencies.
3 own commits and no automated commits, no releases. All three added OpenChamber capture samples at desktop 1440x900, panel-region 1:1 and mobile 390x844 sizes for use as screenshots.
No own commits, 2 issues. The report described reflect --sessions querying legacy V1 tables and returning zero sessions on OpenCode V2; it was closed as resolved.

No own commits, 2 issues. One reported that OpenCode detection and skill install paths point at ~/.opencode instead of ~/.config/opencode; the follow-up requested fixing the skills install path and adding an mcp target for OpenCode v2.
No own commits, 2 issues. Both were listing requests asking for indexing of `sogeisetsu/asset-inventory` and `sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker`.
No own commits, 1 issue. It reported OpenCode V2 compatibility problems with SKILL.md frontmatter and runtime assumptions.
No own commits, 1 issue. The feature request asked to make the harness extensible to OpenCode and Pi and to consider exposing it as an MCP server.
No own commits, 1 PR. The pull request proposed adding `sogeisetsu/asset-inventory` to the list; it was closed without merge.
No own commits, 5 automated commits, no releases. The automated commits were the only activity recorded in this repository during the window.

zh.headline: asset-inventory 与技能发布主导了这 30 天的活动
zh.teaser: sogeisetsu 为 asset-inventory 连发 17 个版本，并有 368 次自动提交更新个人主页；同期在 OpenChamber 与 OpenCode 提交了 59 个 issue。
zh.overview:
### 自有项目

大部分编码工作集中在 `sogeisetsu/asset-inventory`，版本从 v1.3.0 一路推进到 v1.15.0。内容涵盖英语优先重写并配套中文文档、七种语言的文档站点、双语渲染示例页、面向已注册但无法调用资产的新状态标记、发现阶段的安全防护、发布准备脚本与文档一致性门禁，以及以注册表优先的主机命令扫描；文档检查改由 PR 触发的工作流自动执行，SKILL.md 也多次精简。

第二个重心是 `sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch`，版本从 v0.1.0 到 v0.4.0。发布内容包括对无法打开的来源按规则处理、能说明失败原因的校验器、三个协作技能、封装门禁脚本的轻量 `meld.py` 命令行、带明暗主题的双语 Pages 落地页，以及配套 CI 的校验脚本。

OpenCode 技能工具链同样有进展。`opencode-go-model-picker` 从 v1.0.0 发到 v1.4.0，具备按套餐分配模型、三段式输出、agent 发现脚本和支持代理的网络辅助函数；`opencode-skill-management` 发布 v0.2.0，插件通过配置权限规则实现列出、检查、禁用与启用技能；`opencode-agent-sandbox` 则在初始提交之后持续积累知识笔记。

### 主页与博客

`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 改动较多：文案全部改为英文，新增近 30 天活动卡片及每日更新工作流（后改为每两小时滚动更新），修正统计口径使其与拆分一致，升级 CI 动作以摆脱已弃用的 Node 20 运行时。博客仓库则新增了三张 OpenChamber 截图样例。

### 上游反馈

自有仓库之外，活动主要是提交 issue。`openchamber/openchamber` 收到 30 个，涉及多轮运行删除后遗留的 MCP 子进程、AGENTS.md 被过期保存覆盖、切换模型后思考等级未重置、上下文面板百分比计算以及自动更新清单缺失。`anomalyco/opencode` 收到 12 个，集中在 MiMo 模型在 Go 端点上的视觉与子代理故障，以及 Windows 桌面无法调用 CLI。其余为技能插件的 OpenCode V2 兼容性与安装路径报告。

需要说明的是，窗口前几天的数据通过 GitHub Search 回溯，星标数不可用，发布信息仅覆盖自有仓库。本窗口没有缺失日期。

highlights.text: v1.7.0 合并：七种语言、Material 文档站点与渲染示例。
主机命令扫描改为注册表优先，减少清单遗漏已注册命令。
轻量 meld.py 命令行封装六个门禁脚本，技能正文同步精简。
skill_management 插件通过配置规则实现技能列出、检查、禁用与启用。
删除多轮运行后遗留 MCP 子进程，导致 git worktree remove 失败。
MiMo V2.6/V2.5 声称支持图像输入，但 Go 端点对每张图片返回 400。
加强评测在解析、聚合与安装环节的健壮性，已于 2026-10-01 关闭。
提议将中继身份密钥加密存储，并排除在 settings.json 备份之外。
